facts.name: Study Population
facts.description: Patients with radically resected NSCLC of pathological stage IA-T1b, IB, II or IIIA with PRAME expression
facts.source_quote: The patient has radically resected NSCLC * The NSCLC is of pathological stage IA-T1b, IB, II or IIIA NSCLC The surgical technique for resection of the patient's tumor is anatomical, involving at least a segmentectomy The patient's tumor shows expression of PRAME.
